description: For shared propositional formulas \(A,B\), \([A]\leq[B]\) exactly when \(\{A\}\vdash B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.class_le_iff_proof.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf A ≤
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.classOf B ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives {A} B
